_about: Override file. US dollars per 1,000,000 tokens. pr-chain-board gets model prices from the public LiteLLM table, downloaded once a day into the pr-chain work folder (litellm-rates.json). A model listed here uses these numbers instead, matched by name prefix. Runs go through subscriptions, so no money is actually charged per token. Edit a number here and the board picks it up within a minute.
_note: glm-5.3 stays here because LiteLLM lists it only under provider prefixes with different prices, so the bare name has no single rate there; these numbers equal its zai/glm-5.3 entry. gpt-6-luna was removed from this file on 2026-11-13: the LiteLLM entry has the same numbers. Claude models: the dollar amount the Claude harness reports per run wins over the table. gpt-6-luna prompts over 272k tokens bill at a higher tier that the per-run totals cannot show, so its figure is a floor.
